sentiment.reason_en: The VIX sits at 26.80, down 5.27% but still above 20, indicating a defensive market; the S&P 500 closed at 7,182.78 with -0.25%, confirming bearish pressure. The DXY is at 103.71 (+0.04%) and Brent at $92.56 (-2.17%), both pointing to a dollar bias and commodity weakness. Ongoing war in Ukraine and Middle‑East tensions add two bearish points, pushing sentiment toward risk‑off.

market_impact_summary.it: Il mercato azionario globale registra un ritiro: S&P 500 -0,25%, STOXX 600 -1,08% e FTSE MIB +2,36% grazie al rally italiano. Il TLT 20Y sale a 82,24 (+0,92%) mentre il rendimento 10Y USA scende a 4,84% (-1,14%), segnale di compressione dei tassi. L'oro guadagna +4,11% a $3.681,20/oz, ma il suo impatto resta misto. Il Brent scende -2,17% a $92,56, riflettendo il rischio geopolitico sul petrolio. Il DXY leggermente più forte (+0,04%) penalizza gli asset risk‑on.
market_impact_summary.en: Global equities are under pressure: S&P 500 -0.25%, STOXX 600 -1.08% while Italy's FTSE MIB +2.36% leads the rally. The 20‑year TLT rises to 82.24 (+0.92%) as the US 10‑year yield falls to 4.84% (-1.14%), indicating rate compression. Gold climbs +4.11% to $3,681.20/oz, but its impact remains mixed. Brent drops -2.17% to $92.56, reflecting geopolitical risk on oil. The DXY edges higher (+0.04%), weighing on risk‑on assets.
